description: Defines the ITextToSpeech interface, including configuration, speech states, error details, and notification callbacks for Text-to-Speech functionality within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for controlling TTS, setting configurations, and handling speech events.

classes.name: ITextToSpeech
classes.description: Interface for Text-to-Speech operations, including configuration, speech control, and event notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Callback interface for TTS event notifications such as state changes, speech events, errors, and completion.

methods.name: RegisterWithCallsign
methods.description: Register notification callback with a specific callsign.

methods.name: SetFallbackText
methods.description: Set fallback text for specific scenarios.

methods.name: SetAPIKey
methods.description: Set API key for TTS endpoint.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Set access control list for TTS.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: List available TTS voices for a given language.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Convert text to speech and get speech ID.

methods.name: GetSpeechState
methods.description: Get current state of a speech by ID.
